description: Send a WhatsApp-approved message template to a number. Templates are required for sending messages outside the 24-hour window.

components.description: Values for the template placeholders. Preferred shape is a map keyed by component: {"body": ["Acme Ltd", "one-line summary"]} — plain strings in the order the variables appear in the template text ({{1}}, {{2}} …). A template written with NAMED variables ({{customer_name}}, {{order_id}}) also takes the body as a map keyed by variable name, in any order: {"body": {"customer_name": "Reem", "order_id": "A-17"}} — every name in the template text is required and no other name is accepted; a plain list still works and is matched to the names in text order. A text header takes {"title": {"{{1}}": "value"}} (for a named header {"title": {"order_id": "A-17"}} also works); a MEDIA header (image, video, document) takes {"title": {"type": "image", "url": "https://..."}} and counts as a parameter of its own. A dynamic URL button takes {"buttons": {"0": "summer-sale"}} — keyed by the button's 0-based position in the template, and the value is ONLY the variable part that replaces {{1}} in the button URL, not the whole link (the long form {"0": {"sub_type": "url", "type": "text", "{{1}}": "summer-sale"}} also works). The WhatsApp Cloud API component array — [{"type":"body","parameters":[{"type":"text","text":"..."}]}, {"type":"button","sub_type":"url","index":"0","parameters":[{"type":"text","text":"summer-sale"}]}] — is also accepted and converted automatically; for a named template its body parameters may carry Meta's "parameter_name" ({"type":"text","parameter_name":"customer_name","text":"Reem"}) and are matched by that name. Omit for a template with no placeholders. Parameter values must be single-line: a newline or tab is rejected by Meta.

confirm.description: Consent gate — REQUIRED on every call. Pass false first: the tool then performs no action and returns a preview of exactly what would happen. Show that preview to the user, get their explicit approval, and only then call again with true to send this template.

phone.description: Phone number in international format without +

template_name.description: Name of the approved WhatsApp template

name: send_template
